notes: Use visibility_tier='public' for standard public converter dropdowns.
Use visibility_tier='special' only when your data provider explicitly supports market units such as XAU, XAG, XDR, or CLF.
Use visibility_tier='extended' for legacy or transition-period compatibility only.
